bathAction.title: Wash neck
bathAction.tooltip: Wash under the jaw and down to the collarbone.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(tip)] [npc.her] chin up and [npc.verb(wash)] under the jaw, down the sides of [npc.her] neck, and along the collarbone where the sweat has dried. The water carries it off in a thin grey line. [npc.speech(Under the jaw. That is where it sits.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(bare)] [npc.her] throat to the hot water and [npc.verb(drag)] wet fingers slowly from [npc.her] jaw to [npc.her] collarbone. [npc.She] [npc.verb(let)] out [npc.a_moan+] when the heat finds the soft skin there. [npc.speech(Right there. Keep the water on my throat.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(scrub)] [npc.her] neck with the side of [npc.her] hand, brisk, from jaw to chest, and [npc.verb(rinse)] the sweat away without pausing. [npc.speech(Off. All of it. I can smell it on myself.)]
